snippet.title: Kitaria Fables 2 | Overview Trailer (Play the Steam demo now!)
snippet.description:
Prepare for another epic adventure in the magical world of Kitaria in this fun action RPG complete with farming, crafting, and 2 player co-op!

In this ‘Overview Trailer’ new heroes Alice Skylar and Dusty Tuftkin make their long journey across the Endless Ocean to the settlement of Whitewall Town on the remote Arkadera Peninsula. Their goal? To join up with the Royal Academy Expedition Team on its mission to explore the uncharted lands to the north and rebuild the region’s defences so that it’s citizens may once again live in peace and harmony with nature.
Fortunately, Whitewall’s skilled artisans are here to help! 

⚒️ Supply blacksmith Maya with precious materials and rare ores to craft keen weapons and sturdy armour. 
🥕 Use the fertile soil of Aunt Kiki’s farmstead to grow nutritious crops and cultivate exotic natural ingredients. 
⚗️ Learn the delicate art of potion-making with Periwinkle and brew potent concoctions.
🍳 Expand your recipe book and rustle up delicious, nutritious treats with Chef Louis and Wisteria!

Kitaria Fables 2 is coming to Steam, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S in Spring 2027!

 🕹️ Play the Steam demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4665050/Kitaria_Fables_2_Demo/ 
💿 Nintendo Switch 2 and PlayStation 5 physical edition pre-orders now open: https://pqube.co.uk/games/kitaria-fables-2/
